title: AWS Cloud Cost Optimization 2026
intent: Reduce AWS cloud cost by 25 percent across our production workloads over the next two quarters by rightsizing over-provisioned EC2, RDS, and EBS resources, adopting Savings Plans and Reserved Instances for steady-state workloads, decommissioning idle services and unused storage, and tiering cold data to Glacier and Intelligent-Tiering.
goals: Rightsize over-provisioned EC2, RDS, EBS, and Lambda resources flagged by AWS Compute Optimizer and Trusted Advisor
Adopt Savings Plans and 3-year Reserved Instances for steady-state EC2, EKS, and Aurora workloads
Decommission idle clusters, retired services, and unattached resources older than 30 days
Apply S3 lifecycle and Intelligent-Tiering policies to move cold data to Glacier
Track monthly run-rate against the 25 percent reduction target via CloudWatch dashboards and AWS Budgets alerts
